prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Busan — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Busan as her world knows it — a harbour city of a myth-world on a deep blue bay: whitewashed stone and dark pine wood, gently upswept grey-tiled eaves, sailcloth, rope and polished ship's timber, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, camellia blossoms with softly glowing red petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the great bridge, the white tower, fireworks or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a cool, shaded noodle house of the harbour capital on a hot summer day — open lattice windows and bamboo blinds, a bowl of cold wheat noodles in icy broth topped with cucumber, pickled radish and half a boiled egg.
Around her, as her world makes them: a brass bowl of cold wheat noodles in icy broth with cucumber and half a boiled egg; a painted silk folding fan; a pewter cup.
Season: high summer, the beach season — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a fitted marker suit dotted with small reflective markers — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the left of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on the table, her elbow on the table.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks out of the window.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

observations: 밀면과 여름 항구 식당, 창을 보는 턱 괴기 구도를 살렸다.
의상은 계획된 반사 마커 수트보다 전통풍 허리 여밈 상의로 읽힌다.
qa.cause: Outfit의 마커 수트와 World의 시대 조건이 충돌했다.

acceptance: 대표컷 2번 사용자 선택 · 일상컷과 일반 push 사전 승인
